name: Titanium.UI.ListItem
summary: A list item is an individual item in a list section.
description:
A list item is a combination of a [ListDataItem](api:ListDataItem) and [ItemTemplate](api:ItemTemplate).  The list data item
represents the actual data, while the item template represents the style elements of the item.

You should not create `ListItem` objects with a JavaScript factory method, as you do other Titanium proxies.
Instead, you should pass a [ListDataItem](api:ListDataItem) array to the `setItems` method of a `ListSection`. The list data items
contain the data you want to display in the list.

Alloy applications can use **`<ListItem>`** elements to create `ListItem` objects. `<ListItem>` elements
must be nested inside a **`<ListSection>`** element, which itself is nested in a `<ListView>` element,
as shown below:

``` xml
<Alloy>
    <ListView id="list">
        <ListSection id="accounts">
            <ListItem image="images/checking_account.png" title="Checking"/>
            <ListItem image="images/saving_account.png" title="Savings"/>
        </ListSection>
    </ListView>
</Alloy>
```

By default, only the `title`, `image` and `accessoryType` keys of the list data item's
`properties` dictionary are displayed if an item template is not defined.  See "Default List Items"
under "Examples" section for an example of using the default template.


#### Item Templates

To customize the style of a list item, use an item template to create your view structure.

Add key-value pairs of view properties and their values to the `properties` dictionary of the
item template to set view properties of the list item.

**Note:** If possible, do not use `Ti.UI.SIZE` or non-static dimensions to set the
dimensions of view elements in list items.  Instead, try to use static dimensions. Scrolling in
the list view may be jerky if you use non-static dimensions.

Add key-value pairs of event names and their callback functions (or array of callback functions
for multiple callback bindings) to the `events` dictionary of the  item template to bind callbacks
to events, which are bubbled from the subcomponents of the item.

Add additional views, such as labels or image views, to the `childTemplates` array of the item
template. The child templates are item templates with two extra properties:

- Set the `type` property to a Titanium view class, such as `Ti.UI.Label` or `Ti.UI.ImageView`,
  to use that view in your template.
- Set the `bindId` to bind the template to a custom property in the list data item. The custom
  properties in the list data item contain key-value pairs of view properties and their values.

A list template supports the following view classes:

  * [Titanium.UI.ActivityIndicator](api:Titanium.UI.ActivityIndicator)
  * [Titanium.UI.Button](api:Titanium.UI.Button)
  * [Titanium.UI.ButtonBar](api:Titanium.UI.ButtonBar)
  * [Titanium.UI.ImageView](api:Titanium.UI.ImageView)
  * [Titanium.UI.Label](api:Titanium.UI.Label)
  * [Titanium.UI.MaskedImage](api:Titanium.UI.MaskedImage)
  * [Titanium.UI.ProgressBar](api:Titanium.UI.ProgressBar)
  * [Titanium.UI.Picker](api:Titanium.UI.Picker)
  * [Titanium.UI.ScrollableView](api:Titanium.UI.ScrollableView)
  * [Titanium.UI.Slider](api:Titanium.UI.Slider)
  * [Titanium.UI.Switch](api:Titanium.UI.Switch)
  * [Titanium.UI.TextArea](api:Titanium.UI.TextArea)
  * [Titanium.UI.TextField](api:Titanium.UI.TextField)
  * [Titanium.UI.iOS.BlurView](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.BlurView)
  * [Titanium.UI.iOS.LivePhotoView](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.LivePhotoView)
  * [Titanium.UI.iOS.Stepper](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.Stepper)
  * [Titanium.UI.iOS.TabbedBar](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.TabbedBar)

For example, suppose you have a list data item defined as `{foo:{text: 'foobar'}}` and an item
template defined as `{childTemplates: [{type: 'Ti.UI.Label', bindId: 'foo'}]}`.  The `foo`
property in the list data item binds to the label in the template, which sets the `text`
property of the label in the template to the `text` property in the list data item.

To bind the list data item to an item template, use the [Titanium.UI.ListView.templates](api:Titanium.UI.ListView#templates)
property to map the template to a style name, then use the style name to either set the
[Titanium.UI.ListView.defaultItemTemplate](api:Titanium.UI.ListView#defaultItemTemplate) property to globally set the style for all items or set the
`template` property of the list data item to override or individually set the style.

On iOS, you can specify one of the template constants for the [ListDataItem.template](api:ListDataItem#template) property
or [Titanium.UI.ListView.defaultItemTemplate](api:Titanium.UI.ListView#defaultItemTemplate) property: [Titanium.UI.LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_CONTACTS](api:Titanium.UI#LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_CONTACTS),
[Titanium.UI.LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_SETTINGS](api:Titanium.UI#LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_SETTINGS) or [Titanium.UI.LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_SUBTITLE](api:Titanium.UI#LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_SUBTITLE).

#### Eventing

Unlike other views, you cannot use the `addEventListener` method to bind callbacks to events for a
ListItem.

Use list view's [itemclick](api:Titanium.UI.ListView#itemclick) event to monitor click events on
items in the list view. Do not rely on the `source` property to determine which item fired the
event.  Either use the `sectionIndex` and `itemIndex`, or the `itemId` to determine the list item
that generated the event and use the `bindId` to check which child control fired the event.
See "Default List Item" under "Examples" section for an example of using the `itemclick` event.

To monitor events that bubble to the `ListItem` or to monitor events of the view subcomponents,
bind them to the item by using the `events` dictionary of the item template or the child view
templates respectively. Add the bindings as key-value pairs, where the key is the event name
and the value is the callback (or array of callbacks for multiple bindings). See "List Items
with an Item Template" under "Examples" section for an example of binding a `click` event to an
item using an item template.

properties.name: accessoryType
properties.summary: Sets an accessory on the right side of an item.

properties.name: backgroundColor
properties.summary: Background color of the view, as a color name or hex triplet.
properties.description: For information about color values, see the "Colors" section of [Titanium.UI](api:Titanium.UI).

properties.name: backgroundGradient
properties.summary: Background gradient to render when the item is not selected.

properties.name: backgroundImage
properties.summary: Background image to render when the item is not selected.
properties.description: Must be a local resource.

properties.name: backgroundSelectedColor
properties.summary: Background color of the view, as a color name or hex triplet when item is selected.
properties.description:
On Android, clicking on ListItem's sub-views will not trigger this unless these views have 'touchEnabled' set to false.
For information about color values, see the "Colors" section of [Titanium.UI](api:Titanium.UI).

properties.name: backgroundSelectedGradient
properties.summary: Background gradient to render when the item is selected.

properties.name: backgroundSelectedImage
properties.summary: Background image to render when the item is selected.
properties.description:
Must be a local resource.
On Android, clicking on ListItem's sub-views will not trigger this unless these views have 'touchEnabled' set to false.

properties.name: canEdit
properties.summary: Specifies if the item can be deleted by a user initiated action.
properties.description: For more information see the "Editing Support" section of [Titanium.UI.ListView](api:Titanium.UI.ListView).

properties.name: canInsert
properties.summary: Specifies if the item can be inserted by a user initiated action.
properties.description: For more information see the "Editing Support" section of [Titanium.UI.ListView](api:Titanium.UI.ListView).

properties.name: canMove
properties.summary: Specifies if the item can be reordered within the list view by a user initiated action.
properties.description: For more information see the "Editing Support" section of [Titanium.UI.ListView](api:Titanium.UI.ListView).

properties.name: color
properties.summary: Default text color of the item when not selected, as a color name or hex triplet.
properties.description:
For information about color values, see the "Colors" section of [Titanium.UI](api:Titanium.UI).

On Android, `selectedColor` is not supported, so the text is always displayed in this color.

Only applies to the built-in templates.

properties.name: editActions
properties.summary: Specifies custom action items to be shown when when a list item is edited.
properties.description: For more information see the "Editing Support" section of [Titanium.UI.ListView](api:Titanium.UI.ListView).

properties.name: font
properties.summary: Font to use for the item title.
properties.description: Only applies to the built-in templates.

properties.name: height
properties.summary: Row height in platform-specific units.
properties.description:
On Android, the value can be either a float value or a dimension string, for example, '40dp'.
By default, the minimum height is 30 dp on the Android platform.

On iOS, the value can only be an absolute value.

properties.name: image
properties.summary: Image to render in the image area of the item, specified as a local path or URL.
properties.description:
On iOS, the image is on the left, and on Android, the image is on the right.

On Android, this image only appears on the default template.

On iOS, only local images are supported.

On iOS, this image only appears if the ListDataItem `template` property or ListView
`defaultItemTemplate` property is either: [Titanium.UI.LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_DEFAULT](api:Titanium.UI#LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_DEFAULT),
[Titanium.UI.LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_SETTINGS](api:Titanium.UI#LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_SETTINGS) or [Titanium.UI.LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_SUBTITLE](api:Titanium.UI#LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_SUBTITLE).

properties.name: itemId
properties.summary: A user defined string that gets passed to events.

properties.name: searchableText
properties.summary: The text to match against when the [ListView](api:Titanium.UI.ListView) is performing a search.
properties.description: Used in conjunction with [searchView](api:Titanium.UI.ListView#searchView), [searchText](api:Titanium.UI.ListView#searchText) and [caseInsensitiveSearch](api:Titanium.UI.ListView#caseInsensitiveSearch) properties of ListView.

properties.name: selectedBackgroundColor
properties.summary: Background color of the view, as a color name or hex triplet when item is selected.
properties.description:
On Android, clicking on ListItem's sub-views will not trigger this unless these views have 'touchEnabled' set to false.
For information about color values, see the "Colors" section of [Titanium.UI](api:Titanium.UI).

deprecated.notes: This property has been deprecated in favor of <Titanium.UI.ListItem.backgroundSelectedColor>.

properties.name: selectedBackgroundGradient
properties.summary: Background gradient to render when the item is selected.

deprecated.notes: This property has been deprecated in favor of <Titanium.UI.ListItem.backgroundSelectedGradient>.

properties.name: selectedBackgroundImage
properties.summary: Background image to render when the item is selected.
properties.description:
Must be a local resource.
On Android, clicking on ListItem's sub-views will not trigger this unless these views have 'touchEnabled' set to false.

deprecated.notes: This property has been deprecated in favor of <Titanium.UI.ListItem.backgroundSelectedImage>.

properties.name: selectedColor
properties.summary: Color to use for the item title when the item is selected, as a color name or hex triplet.
properties.description:
This property is only used on iOS.

For information about color values, see the "Colors" section of [Titanium.UI](api:Titanium.UI).

properties.name: selectedSubtitleColor
properties.summary: Color to use for the item subtitle when the item is selected, as a color name or hex triplet.
properties.description:
This property is only used on iOS and if the ListDataItem `template` property or ListView
`defaultItemTemplate` property is either: [Titanium.UI.LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_SUBTITLE](api:Titanium.UI#LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_SUBTITLE),
[Titanium.UI.LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_CONTACTS](api:Titanium.UI#LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_CONTACTS) or [Titanium.UI.LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_SETTINGS](api:Titanium.UI#LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_SETTINGS).

For information about color values, see the "Colors" section of [Titanium.UI](api:Titanium.UI).

properties.name: selectionStyle
properties.summary: Selection style constant to control the selection color.
properties.description: Specify one of the constants from <Titanium.UI.SELECTION_STYLE_*>.

properties.name: subtitle
properties.summary: Subtitle to set in the text area of the item.
properties.description:
This subtitle only appears if the ListDataItem `template` property or ListView
`defaultItemTemplate` property is set to either: [Titanium.UI.LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_CONTACTS](api:Titanium.UI#LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_CONTACTS),
[Titanium.UI.LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_SETTINGS](api:Titanium.UI#LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_SETTINGS) or [Titanium.UI.LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_SUBTITLE](api:Titanium.UI#LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_SUBTITLE).

properties.name: subtitleColor
properties.summary: Default text color of the subtitle, as a color name or hex triplet.
properties.description:
This property is only used on iOS and if the ListDataItem `template` property or ListView
`defaultItemTemplate` property is either: [Titanium.UI.LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_SUBTITLE](api:Titanium.UI#LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_SUBTITLE),
[Titanium.UI.LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_CONTACTS](api:Titanium.UI#LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_CONTACTS) or [Titanium.UI.LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_SETTINGS](api:Titanium.UI#LIST_ITEM_TEMPLATE_SETTINGS).

properties.name: title
properties.summary: Title to set in the text area of the item.
properties.description: This title only appears for the built-in templates.
